subject: Post-migration usage spike — goodwill offset & VAT evidence
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greengrid.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greengrid.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected spike after migration — invoice question

Hi Tessa / Logan,

We finished our migration to Redwood Dedicated on Mar 8 and noticed a large, unexpected usage spike on the invoice dated Mar 9. The total charge is ~3x what we expected for normal traffic.

Quick details:
- Invoice: GreenGrid_Invoice_Mar2027.pdf (attached)
- Observed spike window: 2027-03-08 22:00 -> 2027-03-09 03:00 UTC
- We believe a routing misconfiguration during migration routed test traffic to production model pools.

Can you advise on next steps for a goodwill adjustment while you investigate? We can provide the usage CSV and our deployment timeline. Also, we are EU-based and need VAT handling for any credit.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Turner | Head of Platform
GreenGrid Inc
Attachment: GreenGrid_Invoice_Mar2027.pdf (PDF)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greengrid.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike after migration — invoice question

Hi Alex — thanks for flagging and for the invoice. I'm sorry for the disruption during your migration.

We can provisionally apply a goodwill offset while our billing team performs a short audit. To process this cleanly for your EU VAT treatment we need:
- Your VAT ID (company-level) and billing contact (if different)
- The usage CSV showing the spike (if you can share)

Proposed immediate action:
- Preliminary goodwill credit: 40% of the excess amount over baseline, applied as a credit memo (RG-2027-CR-058) within 5 business days.
- Full audit to confirm final adjustment; any delta will be reconciled on the next invoice.
- We will issue credit memo with EU VAT reference and ensure it appears on the customer portal.

If that plan works, please reply with VAT ID and the usage file. I'll loop in Laura to coordinate the credit memo and payment accounting.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike after migration — invoice question

Alex / Samantha — thanks for the VAT ID and the CSV, that was helpful. Summary and next steps below.

Summary of findings (billing quick-audit):
- Confirmed an unusual burst of requests to the production model pool between 2027-03-08 21:55 -> 2027-03-09 03:10 UTC matching your observed window.
- The excess usage aligns with routine test runs that were not gated during migration.

Action plan (agreed):
1) Immediate provisional goodwill offset: we will issue credit memo RG-2027-CR-058 for 40% of the excess amount. The credit memo will include VAT handling for GB (reverse charge) per your VAT ID. It will appear on the portal and be applied to your account within 5 business days.
2) Final reconciliation: our invoices/billing team will complete a one-week detailed audit. Any difference between provisional credit and final validated credit will be posted as either an additional credit or an invoice adjustment on your next bill.
3) Accounting paperwork: Laura will attach the credit memo (PDF) and the internal journal entry reference. If procurement requires a signed statement or PO, Laura will route a short credit confirmation PDF for procurement signature.
4) Preventative: Logan will follow up with our Solutions team to provide a migration checklist and a temporary gating rule to prevent test traffic reaching production pools.

Attachments to follow: RG-2027-CR-058-credit-memo.pdf (provisional) and internal reconciliation ticket link.

If you want us to convert the provisional credit into a direct refund instead of an account credit, let us know and we will run it through our finance approval path (may add 2–3 business days).

Thanks again for raising this quickly — we'll expedite the credit and the audit.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
